name: Dimethyl fumarate
drug_class: Fumaric acid ester (Nrf2 pathway activator, immunomodulator)
route_note: Oral delayed-release capsule twice daily; tablets for psoriasis.
originator: Fumapharm (Switzerland); developed for MS by Biogen

discovery.note: A German chemist with psoriasis proposed fumaric acid esters as treatment; a mixture (Fumaderm) was approved in Germany in 1994 before Biogen developed DMF for MS.

tagline: Oral fumarate for relapsing multiple sclerosis that grew out of a psoriasis remedy
summary: Dimethyl fumarate is an oral immunomodulator used for relapsing multiple sclerosis and psoriasis. Its active metabolite monomethyl fumarate activates the Nrf2 antioxidant pathway and shifts immune responses.
mechanism: After absorption dimethyl fumarate is rapidly hydrolysed to monomethyl fumarate (MMF). MMF modifies cysteine residues on KEAP1, releasing the transcription factor Nrf2 to drive antioxidant and cytoprotective genes.

It also shifts T-cell responses away from pro-inflammatory Th1/Th17 profiles and reduces lymphocyte counts. Flushing is mediated by MMF activation of the niacin receptor HCAR2 on skin cells, releasing prostaglandins.

history.title: Fumarate therapy proposed
history.detail: Walter Schweckendiek publishes on fumaric acid for psoriasis.

history.title: Fumaderm
history.detail: A fumaric acid ester mixture is approved for psoriasis in Germany.

history.title: Biogen acquires Fumapharm
history.detail: Biogen acquires the Swiss company to develop BG-12 for MS.

history.title: DEFINE and CONFIRM
history.detail: Phase 3 trials (NEJM) show roughly halved relapse rates versus placebo.

history.title: FDA approval
history.detail: The FDA approves Tecfidera in March; EU approval follows in 2014.

history.title: PML case
history.detail: A fatal PML case in a patient with prolonged lymphopenia leads to lymphocyte monitoring requirements.

history.title: Diroximel fumarate
history.detail: The related prodrug diroximel fumarate (Vumerity) is approved in the US.

history.title: Generics
history.detail: Generic dimethyl fumarate launches in the US after Biogen loses patent litigation.

pk.bioavailability: not quantifiable for DMF; MMF is the measured active species
pk.metabolism: esterases to MMF, then tricarboxylic acid cycle

serious: Herpes zoster and other serious infections

facts: Most of a dimethyl fumarate dose ends up exhaled as carbon dioxide after entering the citric acid cycle.
